name: ServoMotor
summary: YZ-SERVO-2H ServoMotor is an annular single-axis joint motor driver board with dual magnetic encoder feedback, holding-brake support and dual-port EtherCAT. It is rated for a 48 V DC bus, with 500 W rated and 800 W peak electrical output subject to delivery and thermal conditions. CAN or RS485 is selected by version on a shared connector.
